question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word.

Enormous
solution:
The correct answer is “**Tiny**” 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• "**Enormous**" means extremely large or great in size. (अत्यधिक बड़ा या महान साइज) 

 
 
• **Example**- The impact of the earthquake was enormous and caused many buildings to collapse.
 
 
 
• "**Tiny**" means very small in size. (आकार के हिसाब से बहुत छोटा)
 
 
• **Example**- She wore a tiny silver necklace around her neck.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Enormous" is 'Tiny.'

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **Broad**: This means having a wide range. (व्यापक श्रेणी होना।)
 
• **Huge**: This represents something very large in size.(यह किसी बहुत बड़े आकार की चीज़ को प्रतिष्ठापित करता है।)
 
• **Gorgeous**: This is used to describe something or someone that is very beautiful or attractive. (इसका उपयोग किसी चीज़ या किसी व्यक्ति को वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है)
